verdict: Ads have been paused since September 17; restoring spend is the immediate priority.
narrative: Paid campaigns went dark on September 17 and have not run since, which is why lead volume and spend show zeros for the back half of this 28-day window. The 16 leads and $19.43 cost-per-lead recorded this period came entirely from the days before the pause, all driven by Meta. Ads are being reactivated now, and several infrastructure items — including conversion tracking for Google and a full-stack test — are being completed in parallel so that every dollar spent is measurable when volume resumes. You can expect lead flow to resume once spend is restored; next week's report will reflect the first days back on.
